title: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House

entities.name: Kaito Shizuki
entities.description: A Kamigawan planeswalker who still has his spark; he steals back an iron scroll that was Tamiyo's and then assembles a team to rescue Nashi.

entities.name: Himoto
entities.description: A small spirit companion who rides on Kaito's shoulder and unweaves the spider kami's web around the scroll.

entities.name: The Wanderer
entities.description: The Emperor of Kamigawa, no longer a planeswalker, who walks among her people and asks Kaito's help to find the missing Nashi.

entities.name: Yoshimaru
entities.description: A gold and white dog, the beloved companion of the Wanderer.

entities.name: Nashi
entities.description: Tamiyo's son, a child Reckoner who vanished three months ago through a strange door while following what he took for his mother's voice.

entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: Nashi's dead mother; her iron scroll was confiscated and Kaito steals it back for her family.

entities.name: Genku
entities.description: Someone close to Nashi and to Tamiyo's scrolls, to whom Kaito intends to return the scroll.

entities.name: Light-Paws
entities.description: The one the Wanderer has asked to maintain her regency while she walks among her people.

entities.name: Tyvar Kell
entities.description: An elf prince of Kaldheim who can turn his body to living stone; a boisterous, glory-loving warrior who joins the team.

entities.name: Niko Aris
entities.description: A former planeswalker from Theros who wields shard magic, never misses with a throw, and is bitter at losing their spark.

entities.name: Trygve
entities.description: A burly Kaldheim hunter with braided beard, skilled at throwing axes but a poor bowman.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A former member of the strike team whom Tyvar thinks may be done with adventures.

entities.name: Zimone Wola
entities.description: A Quandrix student from Strixhaven working with the Izzet League on a thesis about extraplanar spaces; she guides Kaito to Niv-Mizzet and joins the team as researcher.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: A massive red dragon on Ravnica, the Guildpact, who guards the strange door and wants to learn its secrets.

entities.name: Madame Etrata
entities.description: A blunt woman without guild insignia who helps arrange the researchers staying on Ravnica.

entities.name: Proft
entities.description: A scoffing man in a long brown coat who is among the researchers studying the door.

entities.name: Aminatou
aliases: the child who spins cocoons of fate
entities.description: A young girl and former planeswalker whose fate magic deflects the House; she makes fateshifter tokens for the team.

entities.name: Marina
entities.description: A teenage girl in antique clothing who moves with her family into the old house long ago and senses something patient waiting in the basement.

entities.name: The House
aliases: the old house on the corner
entities.description: A run-down house with strange angles reached through a door that appears on Ravnica; it is where Nashi disappeared.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: The plane of the Wanderer's birthright, home of the Soratami, Oboro and Kaito.

entities.name: Otawara
entities.description: The gleaming Soratami stronghold in the sky of Kamigawa where recovered artifacts are kept.

entities.name: Oboro
entities.description: The ancient palace of Kamigawa, damaged in the invasion and closed to outsiders.

entities.name: Kaldheim
entities.description: A cold plane where Tyvar fights a wolf and Niko lives.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The city plane where the strange door is guarded by Niv-Mizzet.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: Niko's plane of origin.

entities.name: Omenpaths
entities.description: Stable routes between planes that let people without sparks travel.

entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: The space between planes, no longer felt by sparkless former planeswalkers.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The invading force whose defeat cost many planeswalkers their sparks.

entities.name: Realmbreaker
entities.description: Devastation that damaged Otawara.

entities.name: Soratami
entities.description: The security-minded moonfolk who guard Otawara.

entities.name: Reckoners
entities.description: A group of which Nashi is a member.

entities.name: Izzet League
entities.description: The Ravnican guild whose researchers study the door.

entities.name: Quandrix College
entities.description: The college of Strixhaven University where Zimone studies.

entities.name: Fateshifters
entities.description: Carved figures holding a burst of Aminatou's power that rewind a fatal choice once per person.

entities.name: Iron scroll
entities.description: An iron scroll that was Tamiyo's, guarded by a spider kami in a spirit web.

events.summary: In a flashback many years ago, a family arrives at an old house; the door swings open of its own accord to welcome them.
events.quote: the door swung open of its own accord, as if to welcome them home

events.summary: In the flashback, Marina notices the basement door standing ajar and senses that something patient waits below.
events.quote: That door stood ajar, revealing a thin slice of stairs descending into the darkness.

events.summary: Now, Kaito sneaks through Otawara past the Soratami drones to steal an iron scroll.
events.quote: Pressing himself flat against an alley wall, Kaito Shizuki watched a drone soar by

events.summary: Kaito knocks out a guard at the changing of the guard and picks the lock of the treasure room.
events.quote: Kaito moved behind the guard and hit him on the back of the head with the pommel of his sword.

events.summary: Kaito finds the scroll protected by a spider kami's spirit web and asks Himoto to unweave it.
events.quote: A spider kami hung above the scroll in a delicate spirit web

events.summary: The white-haired Wanderer appears behind Kaito and blocks his blade with her own.
events.quote: The white-haired woman standing behind him offered a slight smile, her sword still lifted to prevent him from completing a stroke.

events.summary: The Wanderer tells Kaito she needs his help because Nashi is in trouble.
events.quote: I came because I need your help. Nashi's in trouble.

events.summary: Kaito, with the scroll in hand, tells the Wanderer he will return it to Genku, Tamiyo's widower, by morning.
events.quote: Genku will have his lost wife's scroll back in the library come morning.

events.summary: The Wanderer reveals Nashi has been missing for three months.
events.quote: Three months.

events.summary: The Wanderer recounts how Nashi followed his mother's voice to a carved door, sent drones through, and then went in with friends, after which the door vanished.
events.quote: He followed her call to a door covered in strange carvings, one that had no place in Kamigawa.

events.summary: The Wanderer says she traced the door's echo through the Omenpaths to Ravnica, where Niv-Mizzet guards it.
events.quote: I found it on Ravnica, being guarded by Niv-Mizzet.

events.summary: On Kaldheim, Tyvar fights a lone wolf and knocks it back with a stone-fisted punch.
events.quote: The wolf, which was easily twice his size, leapt, and Tyvar swung a mighty left hook at the soft underside of its jaw

events.summary: Kaito finds Tyvar and recruits him for the rescue; Tyvar eagerly agrees.
events.quote: When do we leave?

events.summary: Tyvar vouches for Niko Aris, a former planeswalker, as the defensive fighter Kaito needs.
events.quote: I think I may have just the hero that you need

events.summary: Niko splits Trygve's thrown axe, and then their own, with two throws.
events.quote: The first struck the handle of Trygve's axe, splitting it lengthwise.

events.summary: Niko shows their shard magic, says the invasion did not take it, and agrees to come along.
events.quote: Can't let the Planeswalkers have all the fun.

events.summary: Kaito arrives on Ravnica and wonders why he kept his spark when so many others lost theirs; Niko is bitter at their loss.
events.quote: Kaito stepped out of forever onto the streets of Ravnica

events.summary: Kaito meets Zimone, a Strixhaven student sent by Niv-Mizzet to wait for him.
events.quote: I'm Zimone. I'm a student? Quandrix College, at Strixhaven University.

events.summary: Zimone leads the group to a courtyard where Kaito presents Tyvar and Niko to the dragon Niv-Mizzet.
events.quote: The alley ended in a small courtyard, dominated by a massive red dragon lounging on the far side like a cat

events.summary: Niv-Mizzet reveals that a girl called Aminatou has already arrived, saying the team will need her help; Niko recognizes the name.
events.quote: A young girl, younger than Zimone here, who calls herself Aminatou.

events.summary: Niv-Mizzet admits the necromantic contamination warning is a pretext to clear the area for research.
events.quote: We just needed to clear the area to conduct our research.

events.summary: At the door, researchers surround it; Aminatou recoils in fear and warns that it hears them.
events.quote: Aminatou gasped and recoiled as her eyes locked on the door.

events.summary: Zimone reports that Nashi's drones recorded a house with distorted space on the other side.
events.quote: Just a house, perfectly normal, if in need of a good cleaning service.

events.summary: Aminatou explains her fateshifters, which rewind a fatal choice once, and says anyone refusing them will not come back.
events.quote: When you make a choice that would lead to your certain death, everyone nearby who holds a token will see the outcome

events.summary: Aminatou hands out the fateshifter tokens, giving the Wanderer a second.
events.quote: She handed them around the members of the team, giving the Wanderer a second.

events.summary: The Wanderer asks Aminatou to mind Yoshimaru while the team goes in.
events.quote: Will you mind Yoshimaru for me?

events.summary: The team takes Etrata's monitoring devices and files through the door into the House.
events.quote: One by one, the group filed inside.

events.summary: The door slams shut behind the team as Aminatou, Etrata, Proft and Niv-Mizzet watch.
events.quote: Then the door closed, and the House was all.

relations.note: Old friends; she calls him old friend.
She is its Emperor and has left Light-Paws as regent.
relations.quote: she had asked Light-Paws to maintain her regency for now

relations.note: Rides on his shoulder and helps with the heist.
relations.quote: On Kaito's shoulder, Himoto adjusted her position
finally joyous again in the company of his beloved master
the scroll containing his mother's living memory had vanished

relations.note: He told other Reckoners about the lost scroll.
relations.quote: he told some of the other Reckoners that the scroll containing his mother's living memory had vanished

relations.note: Niv-Mizzet guards the door and controls access to it.

relations.quote: this is my friend Niko Aris

relations.note: A welcome friend from earlier adventures.
relations.quote: What brings you to Kaldheim, my friend?
I'm Zimone. I'm a student? Quandrix College, at Strixhaven University.
Mr. Guildpact, I found the search team

relations.note: Niko resents Aminatou, who accepts being hated.
relations.quote: I understand why you hate me.
